texts.name: Elderian
texts.biography: Elderian, living in Enroth, seeks to research forbidden magic. He has visited many scholars but cannot find what he truly seeks. It is said that he can complete his research in Burton. He wouldn't care even if it meant joining the ranks of evil.

specialty.name: Automatons
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Automatons and Sentinel Automatons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
